mapper.insert: INSERT INTO recipe_change_notice (notify_id, workshop_code, creator, change_content, status, retry_count, max_retry) VALUES (#{notifyId}, #{workshopCode}, #{creator}, CAST(#{changeContent,typeHandler=com.baomidou.mybatisplus.extension.handlers.JacksonTypeHandler} AS JSONB), #{status}, #{retryCount}, #{maxRetry}) ON CONFLICT (notify_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT id, notify_id, workshop_code, change_content, status, retry_count, max_retry FROM recipe_change_notice WHERE status = 15 AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time ASC, id ASC
SELECT id, notify_id, workshop_code, change_content FROM recipe_change_notice WHERE id = #{noticeId} AND deleted = 0
